name: Bare winter canes, red hips 015
prompt: a dense sprawling bramble thicket of dark green leaves and thick arcing thorny stems, a low lush leafy mass hugging the ground with wild roses scattered through it, bare winter canes, red hips, waist-high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: glowworms strung along the arching canes

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the small green lights on the canes brighten a little and return, one after another. Nothing in the picture may change size, shape or position. The last frame must return to exactly how the first frame looks, so the loop joins. Nothing may become darker than it is in the first frame. Everything else is frozen and pixel-for-pixel identical. Do not redraw anything else, and do not add or remove anything.

LIT_2.glow_concept: petals shedding slow drifting motes of light

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the gold sparks above the thicket brighten a little and return, one after another. It is lit and clearly visible in every frame, including the first. It gets only SLIGHTLY brighter -- never white, never washed out -- and keeps its own colour throughout: brightest in the middle, back to its first-frame brightness at the end, never dimmer at the end than the start. The things carrying it keep exactly the shape, size, position and number they have in the first frame. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour, no outline redrawn. The last frame matches the first exactly.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
